props.description: The code. Ignored when `files` is given.
props.name: code

props.description: The language, highlighted and shown as a tag: ts, tsx, js, json, css, html, bash, md, yaml, sql, diff.
props.name: language

props.description: A file name or caption over the code.
props.name: title

props.description: Several files, one tab each (`title`, `code`, `language`); replaces `code`, `title` and `language`.
props.name: files

props.description: Lines to highlight, from 1: numbers and ranges such as `[2, "4-6"]`.
props.name: highlightLines

props.description: Reads a leading `+` as an inserted line and `-` as a deleted one; the copy button copies the result.
props.name: isDiff

props.description: A prompt drawn before each line and left out of selection and copy, such as `$` for shell commands.
props.name: prompt

props.description: Shows the copy button; on by default.
props.name: isCopyable

props.description: The copy button's accessible name; "Copy" by default.
props.name: copyLabel

props.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways (the start state when `showWrapToggle` is on).
props.name: isWrapped

props.description: Shows a header button that turns wrapping on and off.
props.name: showWrapToggle

props.description: The lines shown before a "Show all N lines" button (no inner scroll); 30 by default, `0` for all.
props.name: maxLines

props.description: `auto` follows the page's scheme; `light` or `dark` keep the block in that scheme.
props.name: theme

props.description: Any JSON value: a payload, a webhook body, an event.
props.name: value

props.description: The tree's accessible name, such as "Webhook payload".
props.name: label

props.description: How many levels start open; 1 by default.
props.name: defaultExpandDepth
